title: Astrid and the Portrait
author: Coral Zhou
blurb: Ulyana Winterbourne, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
